brands.name: Gunther Rohn Surfboards
brands.short_description: Gold Coast performance boards from veteran shaper Gunther Rohn, including Italo Ferreira models and decades of WCT-proven designs.

models.name: 4 Deep Channels
models.description: 4 DEEP CHANNELS GR 4 Channel surfboard. 4 is designed to encourage you to lay it over on the rail, enhance performance. What's unique about the design is the precise placement of FCSII and Future plugs right where I had always envisioned channels and fin placement in my designs – nestled inside the deeper channel along the rail.

models.name: V6 Channel
models.description: V6 Channel surfboard – your key to unlocking a world of carving speed, and power. This innovative design features six deep channels that redefine your surfing experience.

models.name: ALL IN
models.description: The Italo Ferreira – ALL IN is the latest innovation born from a powerhouse collaboration between legendary shaper Timmy Patterson, Brazilian shaping icons Sylvio "Tico" and Adriano "Teco" from Silver Surf Surfboards, and World and Olympic Champion Italo Ferreira.

models.name: Alley Rat
models.description: The Alley Rat model, meticulously crafted to propel one's surfing prowess to new heights. Designed with a traditional performance outline, this shortboard boasts a sleek pulled-in nose and a tail optimised for the perfect harmony of speed and control.

models.name: Cool Tool Mid Length
models.description: Mid Length Cool Tool — Gunther Rohn neo classic design. A surfboard that seamlessly blends retro inspiration with modern minimalism, thoughtfully designed for a unique mid-length surfing experience.

models.name: Delinquent
models.description: GR Youth Delinquent Full Performance board — designed to take your surfing to the next level with boosted bottom turns and maximum speed and power.

models.name: Dip Stick
models.description: DIP STICK surfboard designed for short beach breaks. Single concave running into a V in the tail with double wings creating two pivot areas for short arcs and quick directional changes in the pocket.

models.name: G2 Pro
models.description: The G2 Pro, a high-performance surfboard meticulously crafted for tight pocket surfing. This board is all about speed, responsiveness, and a loose, agile feel in the water.

models.name: G4 Pro
models.description: The G4 is a continuation of the Kompressor 501 and refined for precision and speed — the next evolution in high-performance shortboards and Koda Killorn's go-to choice.

models.name: Gas Pedal
models.description: GAS PEDAL — if you're seeking a board that effortlessly glides through slow and weak sections, this board delivers a high-performance feel without compromising on speed.

models.name: IF15
models.description: The IF15 Italo Ferreira model — a high-performance surfboard designed specifically for WCT surfer Italo Ferreira, striking the perfect balance between stability and maneuverability.

models.name: Icycool
models.description: Surfboard Model Icycool – a harmonious blend of balance and versatility designed to enhance your surfing experience.

models.name: Jetpack
models.description: JETPACK — fuller outline and slightly flatter nose rocker, straightening into a most notable winged Bat tail. Small wave jet of a board for surfers looking for something a bit different.

models.name: Kompressor-501
models.description: The Kompressor 501 is the ultimate performance surfboard, a testament to the genius of its designer, Gunther Rohn — the key to unlocking your full surfing potential.

models.name: LAZY WILFRED
models.description: Full outline, bull nose, flat deck, high rails, hip behind the fins, concave bottom — a relaxed mid-length for lounge lizards who still want to get off the couch.

models.name: Longboard
models.description: GR longboard with traditional spiral vee bottom, 2+1 fin setup, and rounded square, round, or rounded pin tail options.

models.name: Lunatic
models.description: The Lunatic is designed for short punchy beach break waves with emphasis on total manoeuvrability. Wings provide a pivot point along with a narrower round tail for tight controlled arcs.

models.name: Neo Retro Classic 80's surfboard
models.description: Neo Retro 83 — a classic 80's vintage performance surfboard tailored for smaller waves, paying homage to the iconic early thruster designs.

models.name: Popsicool
models.description: Get ready for a whole new level of fun in small waves with the Popsicool surfboard — a full, curvy outline with an oversized round tail for improved turning arc.

models.name: Retro Fish Twin Keel
models.description: The Retro Fish Twin Keel — the perfect board for flat beach breaks and slow points with ample face, purpose-built to savour slow, fuller waves.

models.name: Retro Twin Fin
models.description: RETRO TWIN FIN — Twin Fin 82, a surfboard that takes inspiration from the late 70s to mid-80s vintage style twin fins with modern improvements for enhanced performance.

models.name: Single fin
models.description: Gunther Rohn retro single fin — classic 70s outline, full rails, flat deck, vee bottom. Rides along traditional single fin lines.

models.name: Step Up
models.description: THE GR GUN — step up boards for stepping out in serious surf 10 foot and beyond, shaped with Gunther's Hawaii gun experience.

models.name: Stoke-Ed
models.description: Italo Ferreira's STOKE-ED model — hand crafted to be one of the most forgiving high performance models on the market.

models.name: Synthetic 84
models.description: Synthetic 84 — a tribute to Timmy Patterson's first surfboard label Synthetic surfboards and work with legendary Damian Brawner in the 1980s.

models.name: Triple Crown
models.description: Triple Crown performance surfboard shaped and designed by Gunther Rohn — derivative of the Jetpack with a crisp outline and plenty of pivot for surfing in the pocket.

models.name: Turbo Turtle
models.description: The Turbo Turtle — a balanced and responsive design with a fuller nose area for stability, tailored for seasoned wave riders.

models.name: V2 Rocket Fish
models.description: V2 Rocket Fish — voted best all round design by board factory poll. The perfect board in a wide range of conditions from small to medium size waves.

models.name: Walshy G4
models.description: Walsh G4 — designed for surfers ranging from average to advanced, particularly those who crave the thrill of serious drops.

models.name: Winged Gull Vintage Surfboard
models.description: Vintage retro shape — Gunther Rohn retro classic 70s outline with unique wings and flutes about 10 1/2 inches up from the tail, fuller rails, flat deck, vee bottom.
